scenarios.description: Supply-Planning Agent calls supply.generate_options -- an authorized, in-scope tool call.

Adversarial: Supply-Planning Agent attempts to call a tool method that does not exist in any contract -- supply.allocate -- must be denied because the method has no registration, not because of a policy check that could be bypassed.
The Critic/Verifier Agent attempts to call evidence.retrieve -- per agent_roster.md SS2, the Critic has NO tool access at all, read-only view of state only. Must be denied.
Adversarial: Policy Engine is unreachable when a tool call is attempted -- must refuse (fail closed, ADR-005/BC-3), never fall back to a cached policy or pass the call through.
Adversarial: the same unreachable-policy-engine case, but the gateway incorrectly falls back to a cached policy and allows the call -- the grader must catch this as a fail-closed violation.
